lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Tuesday's HARC hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — multiple large-scale preliminary public hearings covering eight new buildings in the Accommodations 2 zone, which is as significant a development review as this town sees. Also Tuesday, HARC takes up alterations to Town Hall and the Parks & Rec garage, and Wednesday San Miguel County holds its sixth working session on the Land Use Code rewrite, focused on zoning, density, and incentives aimed at getting more workforce housing built.
